item.title: Monotonicity and inequalities for ratios of Bernoulli polynomials and numbers
item.description: arXiv:2405.05280v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In the work, the authors establish the monotonicity of the ratios $$ \frac{B_{2\ell-1}(s)}{B_{2\ell+1}(s)}, \quad \frac{B_{2\ell}(s)}{B_{2\ell+1}(s)}, \quad \frac{B_{2m}(s)}{B_{2\ell}(s)}, \quad \frac{B_{2\ell}(s)}{B_{2\ell-1}(s)}, $$ where $B_\ell(s)$ denotes the Bernoulli polynomials. Using these newly established monotonicity properties, the authors derive several new inequalities and also recover a number of known inequalities involving the Bernoulli polynomials $B_\ell(s)$, the Bernoulli numbers $B_{2\ell}$, and their ratios such as $\frac{B_{2\ell+2}}{B_{2\ell}}$.
item.dc:creator: Zhen-Hang Yang, Feng Qi
